nodes.title: READ ME
widgets_values:
# H3 FaceRefine Plus - one shot

Re-renders the face of **one shot** with MiniMax H3 (Ref2VA) on a 2x upscale of the shot, pastes it back, removes the paste wobble and brings the colour back to the source.

**Needs**
- ComfyUI-H3-FaceRefine (Face Select, Track + Crop, Inject Video Latent, Per-Frame Denoise)
- this pack, ComfyUI-H3-FaceRefine-Plus (Stitch Plus, Flow Lock, Tone Match)
- the MiniMax H3 nodes (Reference To Video, Native Audio Lock) and models
- ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite (Video Combine)
- an NVIDIA RTX GPU for RTX Video Super Resolution (or swap in another 2x upscaler, see step 1)
- `face_yolov8m.pt` in `models/ultralytics/bbox`
- ffmpeg on the PATH (Load Video FFmpeg and Video Combine use it)

**Input:** ONE shot, with no cuts inside. Cut the clip at its scene changes first.
**Length:** H3 works on 17k+5 frames: 22, 39, 56, 73, 90, 107, 124, 141... Use a shot of exactly one of those lengths, or trim it DOWN to one with `frame_load_cap` (step 1). A longer shot is padded up to the next length, and the faces of the padded last group come out as a grid of noise.
**Output:** the refined shot at the source size, with its audio, ready to splice back into the clip.

**Try the example first:** copy the contents of the repo's `assets/` folder to `ComfyUI/input/h3plus_example/`, set the full path of `mara/sample_shot.mp4` in the string node (1), and Queue. The pictures and the prompt (`assets/mara/sample_shot_prompt.txt`) are already set.

**Your own shot:** set the shot path (1), the three reference pictures (3) and the prompt (4). Make the keyref with the companion workflow `face_refine_plus_keyref_qwen_workflow.json`.
All the other values are the tested defaults.

Example run (mara): 107 frames (4.46 s) at 1536x896, face 45-62 px tall: 256 s on an RTX 5090 for the whole graph (RTX upscale included, models already loaded). On a music-video shot (face about 150 px) the result vs the source was within 0.8 on the lips (dL/da/db) and 0.35 on the skin, wobble 0.23 % of the face height.

nodes.title: Note: 1 - Load shot + RTX x2
widgets_values:
## 1 - Load the shot + RTX x2

- **shot path** (the string node): full path of ONE shot. It feeds both loaders, so you set it once.
  - Its audio is loaded from the same file and drives Audio Lock.
- **frame_load_cap** (Face Select AND Load Video FFmpeg, same value): 0 loads the whole shot. If the shot is not 17k+5 frames long (22, 39, 56, 73, 90, 107, 124, 141...), set both to the largest of those that fits, e.g. 107 for a 119-frame shot.
- **Face Select, select:** `largest_face` for a single subject. Use left / right / index when there are several people.
- **Load Video FFmpeg:** the SAME shot, read by ffmpeg with its colour tags. It is the colour reference for Tone Match (step 6).
  - Don't replace it with Load Video or with the Face Select frames.
  - ComfyUI's own loader (PyAV) and VHS Load Video (OpenCV) decode BT.709 video with the BT.601 matrix.
  - Video Combine saves real BT.709, so a load + save turns faces darker and more magenta, and lips purple (lips dL -2.6, db -3.2 with no processing at all).
- **RTX Video Super Resolution x2 (ULTRA):** the face is refined on the 2x frames, so H3 sees more pixels and draws more detail.
  - 2.0 is recommended. 1.5 stays a little closer to the source, with less detail.
  - If you change the scale, set the final Scale (step 6) to 1 / scale.
- **No RTX GPU?** Replace this node with any 2x upscaler.

nodes.title: Note: 3 - Reference pictures
widgets_values:
## 3 - Reference pictures (Ref2VA)

The order of the ref_image inputs is the `<Picture N>` order in the prompt, **counting from 0**. Add more images (location, other people) after these and refer to them as `<Picture 3>`, `<Picture 4>`...
- **<Picture 0> face_reference:** the subject's face reference, the one used to make the clip.
- **<Picture 1> character_sheet:** the subject's character sheet.
- **<Picture 2> keyref:** one frame of THIS shot with the face edited (Qwen Image Edit) to look like the subject. Make it with `face_refine_plus_keyref_qwen_workflow.json`; the example is `keyref_qwen.png`.

Tip: build the keyref from a crop of a **close-up of the same clip**. The refined face then matches the clip's close-ups (in our tests, identity vs close-ups 0.74 -> 0.78).

In the prompt, say what the keyref is for, e.g. *`<Picture 2>` is a sharp close-up of the face of `<Subject 1>` exactly as it appears in this shot: use it for the fine facial detail.*

nodes.title: Note: 5 - Sampling + refine strength
widgets_values:
## 5 - Sampling + refine strength

er_sde sampler, 8 steps. The denoise comes from **H3 FaceRefine Plus Strength (preset)**:
- **standard 0.15** (recommended): keeps the identity, expression and colours of the face H3 drew; least wobble.
- **strong 0.30** (older default): re-draws the face more, toward the reference pictures. On small faces it looks more like the character (mara, 41-62 px: identity vs close-ups 0.41 -> 0.67), with no extra sharpness and slightly more wobble. On faces around 100 px it changes little.
- **custom**: any value. 0.45 + keyref gives a different-looking person: single clips only, never inside a music video.

**The higher the strength, the more the face is changed.** Keep the seed fixed when you compare settings.

nodes.title: Note: 4 - Face crop + H3 conditioning
widgets_values:
## 4 - Face crop + H3 conditioning

- **Track + Crop:** crop_factor 2.2, canvas `auto_capped_768` (canvas up to 768 px, at least 512).
  - Avoid small manual canvases (384 / 320): in tests the face looked less like the subject.
- **prompt:**
  - start with the SAME subject definitions as the clip;
  - then describe this shot only: action, framing, lighting;
  - refer to the reference images as `<Picture N>`.
- **Inject Video Latent** puts the cropped frames into the latent, so H3 starts from them.
- **Audio Lock** keeps the mouth in sync with the real audio.
- **Per-Frame Denoise** with multipliers 1.0 gives the same strength on every frame.

nodes.title: Note: 6 - Paste back + anti-wobble + colour
widgets_values:
## 6 - Paste back, anti-wobble, colour

- **Stitch Plus** (`freq_sep`, `face_only`):
  - the H3 detail goes on top of the 2x base;
  - the base keeps the tone and the low frequencies;
  - the mask edge is antialiased.
- **Flow Lock:** H3 redraws the eyes and mouth 1-2 px off on every frame, so the face seems to slide on the head.
  - Optical flow pulls the features back onto the base.
  - sigma_frac 1/150 of the height, threshold 4.
  - base_offset 0: base and refined start on the same frame.
- **Tone Match:** brings L/a/b back to the source at low frequency: sigma luma 1/100 of the height, chroma 1/300.
  - It fixes the BT.601/BT.709 decode shift (see step 1), the upscaler drift and the H3 drift.
  - **source_images must come from Load Video FFmpeg.** Loaded any other way, the source carries the same shift and nothing gets fixed.
  - **lip_fix** moves the lips back to the source tone and keeps the refined detail.
  - Its report is shown in the preview node.
- **Scale 0.5:** back to the source size. Use 1 / your upscale factor.
- **Video Combine:** saves the shot with its audio. Splice it back into the clip in place of the original shot.
